assessmentConstraint: Do not provide a fresh introduction explaining the assessed relation, a worked solution, or the decisive answer immediately before an independent assessment. Existing notation, raw factual observations and neutral reading conventions may be provided only to make the material accessible.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: A single given-rule ordering operation, with groups and sequences as alternative outcomes. The EG1 grade5/6 clause does not require independent criterion invention. Task material supplies traits and criteria, while the actual assignments must be new learner work.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: The EG2 grade9/10 table distinguishes exactly two units of reference. Identifying the unit in a new statement is one assessable discrimination, with location/time/species defining the population. Multiple measurements from one organism remain one organism.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW7 grade9/10 asks for an explanation of sexual versus asexual reproduction along one explicit dimension, variability. Existing two recombination atoms provide the chromosomal models. The explanation remains causal and conditional, without claiming guaranteed advantage or no clonal mutations.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW7 grade5/6 explicitly permits a selected organism group. Four native deciduous species form one bounded recognition repertoire; species name and identifying traits constitute one recognition performance. A new unlabelled specimen must carry the recognition assessment. Local occurrence is not silently claimed.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW7 grade5/6 requires explaining breeding through suitable variants. Repeated selection of parents with heritable traits is one coherent process. The new example requires an actual choice; selection neither creates need-directed variants nor guarantees identical offspring.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW7 grade9/10 contrasts inherited adaptation with non-inherited adjustment. Heritability, lifetime/generations and organism/population are decision criteria of one contrast. Given evidence supports a new decision without providing it. The epigenetic boundary avoids an invalid universal claim.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW8 grade5/6 asks for interpretation as an indication. Observation plus a limited causal interpretation is one competence, with chance/environment and non-biological family forms handled honestly. Fictional material avoids private family enquiries.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW8 grade5/6 requires common ancestry as the explanation of observed similarities. Present relatives are not misrepresented as the literal direct ancestors of every individual. Checked descent material can be supplied without supplying the causal explanation.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: The full FW8 grade5/6 clause explicitly names all five groups and common traits. One bounded comparative body-trait scheme is a coherent content goal, assessable in a single comparative task. Separate physiology, phylogenetics and species catalogues are excluded. Traditional school groups are not incorrectly claimed to be five equivalent clades.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW8 grade7/8 requires actual hierarchical placement from morphology/anatomy. The hierarchy convention may be shown; a new placement and its trait justification must be supplied by the learner. This is distinct from an arbitrary flat grouping and from molecular phylogeny.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW7 grade9/10 specifies the simple reproductive-community criterion. The candidate applies it to suitable sexual-reproduction examples using actual reproduction/fertility evidence, without claiming to solve all species concepts.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: FW7 grade9/10 explicitly requires mutation without molecular genetics and recombination. Their contrasting effects on within-species differences are one causal comparison. Actual chromosomal gene/product/trait and recombination prerequisites support it; no DNA mechanism is smuggled in.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.

perGoal.requiredLearnerOperation: The two FW7 grade9/10 clauses jointly require causal population adaptation and the interplay of mutation, recombination and selection. A single through-going explanation links existing variability to differential reproduction and changed frequencies. Selection is not a generator of new variants; survival alone is insufficient.
perGoal.ifMissingPrerequisiteOrModelUnderstandin: Return to teaching and collect new unprimed evidence later; do not count a just-shown relation as independent mastery.
